programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: Police officer, SIT TAN-YAN (Johnson Lee), is a no ordinary man because he possesses authentic knowledge and skills in geomancy that he learned from his grandfather, and often manages to solve mysterious cases at critical moments. On top of that, having his best friend LEUNG SING-KAU (Oscar Leung), who has connections on both sides of the law, be his informant, his style of work amazes his superior CHE KWAI-FEI (Joey Meng) very much. As a criminal psychologist, KWAI-FEI makes a decision solely based on rational factors. Though the two seem to be poles apart, they have developed a close rapport with each other. Apart from her job, KWAI-FEI, being the matriarch of her family, cares for nothing but the future of her younger sister CHE KWAI-MEI (Harriet Yeung) and brother CHE KWAI-KWAN (Fred Cheng). When KWAI-MEI gets caught up in a love triangle involving SING-KAU and KWAI-FEI's subordinate TIT LEUNG-CHI (Rebecca Zhu), KWAI-FEI becomes out of control, fortunately, she gets help from TAN-YAN. Meanwhile, there have been consecutive reports of kidnapped persons in town, and the abduction method evokes TAN-YAN's memories of the past that he has hidden for years. Without hesitation, KWAI-FEI risks her own life to investigate the cases, whereas TAN-YAN predicts that something is going to happen......

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: While being instructed to investigate some transnational crime, OCTB officers Hui Chun-sum (Ruco Chan) and Shum Wai-lik (Ben Wong) find out Ngai Chi-lok (Cheung Wing Hong), who was the culprit behind the Tiger Cull case, sent some secret message to the dark web before he was apprehended. He also made a transfer of a substantial amount in cryptocurrency. And soon some mysterious person plots to launch a terrorist attack. Although Chun-sum and Wai-lik solve the case with the help of the talented Prof Tong Kwun-fung (Alex Fong), but they are shocked to realize there is some more evil conspiracy hidden behind Chi-lok! While they just have to foil Chi-lok's scheme, they also have to deal with strange cases such as dragon head rod crisis, white bones in empty space and hardened criminal jailbreak. And are they able to clear away obstacles? While crisis escalates in the workplace, there are also challenging love issues. Chun-sum hopes to be reunited with his ex-girlfriend Ma Wing-sze (Lam Ha Mei). However, the couple's relationship is kind of iffy as they have deal with so many problems.

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men
programme.desc: Dear Children is a nostalgic family period drama that chronicles the lives of siblings and friends growing up in a factory community during China's reform era in the late 1970s and 1980s. programme.title: Wo Jiao Zhang Si De
programme.desc: Set during the Chinese Communist Revolution, this historical drama follows the life of Zhang Side, a humble peasant from Sichuan who joined the Red Army. Rather than portraying him as an oversized hero, the series focuses on his quiet work ethic and selflessness—from surviving the Long March to serving as a guard in Yan'an. In 1944, Zhang tragically dies when a charcoal kiln collapses, sacrificing his life to save a fellow soldier and leaving behind an enduring legacy of selfless service

programme.title: Jue Mi Shi Ming
programme.desc: In the early 1930s, the Communist Party established a top-secret underground route connecting Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shantou, and Fujian to their main base in Ruijin to bypass severe military blockades. Disguised as ordinary shopkeepers, boatmen, and doctors, covert couriers risked their lives to outsmart enemy forces. Together, they smuggled vital intelligence, essential supplies, and safely escorted key leaders—including Zhou Enlai—across enemy lines

programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao
programme.desc: This historical drama follows the turbulent lives of the Ye brothers, Sun Zhongyi and Huangfu Zaiqing, alongside the three daughters of Sun Jingchun—a renowned opera performer from Ziyang Street. Spanning from the War of Resistance through decades of separation across the Taiwan Strait to the modern era, the story weaves together romance, family feuds, intelligence warfare, and changing times. As the characters navigate love, heartbreak, and unexpected twists of fate, they remain tied to their shared devotion to their country and family.

Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: The Ark of the World: Austronesian Taiwan 115
programme.desc: Broadcast live from Taitung, Taiwan's 2026 National Day celebration brings together cultural performances and a spectacular fireworks display. Framed by the theme The Ark of the World: Austronesian Taiwan, the event celebrates the island's ocean heritage and shared national spirit. 2026

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his family's reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting (William Chan). Cheung (Derek Tsang) and Dong (Edward Chui) are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the other's parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents' first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the “midnight gymnasium” programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Choi's past?

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Choi's past?

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sect's Zhang Chui Shan's son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translator's son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a sharp downturn after the birth of her daughter. Exhausted by the demands of caring for a newborn and neglected by her indifferent husband, she finds herself caught in growing family conflicts, postnatal turmoil, and unyielding work stress. Through long and lonely nights, will the dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2009
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away...

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Call of Heroes
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleuth—each guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joe's guilty conscience and Veronica's hopes intensify.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the "China-Russia Train Robbery" where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead…

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estate—a testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation…

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiancé, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friend's final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the world's greatest fright.

programme.title: It's A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Table for Six 2

However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friend's company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

To thank the driver, the boy's dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wang's which seem to be related to the accident.

A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the city's renowned “Dumpling Queen”.

programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire

During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an “e-ghost” on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the “e-ghost” also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. programme.title: Cold War
